# STAMPED in Practice: initial study poster

[stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg](stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg) is an editable **44 × 44 inch** initial poster source with live text and a `3168 × 3168` viewBox.
The [PNG preview](stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png) is for screen review.
This layout contains no experiment findings and is awaiting author review.

ABCD data access was not obtained, so the planned scientific result has not been reproduced.
The proposed public-data studies do not resolve that controlled-data access limitation.
The seven-property table distinguishes implementation examples from **PENDING** evidence, effort, failures, tradeoffs, and gaps.
The study question, dataset, sample size, and metric also remain pending; no general benefit from skills is demonstrated.

Author order provisionally follows the conference program: John A. Lee, Austin Macdonald, Cody C. Baker, and Yaroslav O. Halchenko.
Confirm the order before publication.
The descriptive subtitle is provisional; the submitted title remains in the [accepted abstract](../stamped-abcd-poster-draft.md).

## Edit and regenerate

Edit [build_initial_poster.py](build_initial_poster.py) to change the content or layout reproducibly, then regenerate the SVG.
The SVG can also be edited directly in a vector editor, but regeneration overwrites those direct edits.
From this directory:

```bash
python3 build_initial_poster.py
uv run --with cairosvg cairosvg stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg \
  --output-width 1584 --output-height 1584 \
  --output stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png
```

The builder uses the Python standard library; preview rendering needs CairoSVG and the Cairo system library.
With dependencies already cached, add `--offline` to `uv run`.
The SVG retains its physical dimensions regardless of preview resolution.
Licensing follows the repository's existing [REUSE.toml](../../REUSE.toml) annotations.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import cairosvg
from PIL import Image

folder = Path("2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study")
source = Path("../research/poster-context")
for name in (
    "stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg",
    "build_initial_poster.py",
    "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png",
):
    assert (folder / name).read_bytes() == (source / name).read_bytes(), name
    print("Source copy matches:", name)
svg = folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg"
original = svg.read_bytes()
root = ET.fromstring(original)
assert root.tag == "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg"
assert root.attrib["width"] == root.attrib["height"] == "44in"
assert root.attrib["viewBox"] == "0 0 3168 3168"
assert root.findall(".//{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}text")
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(folder / "build_initial_poster.py")], check=True)
assert svg.read_bytes() == original, "Regenerated SVG differs"
proof = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stamped-ai-study-proof-")) / "preview.png"
cairosvg.svg2png(url=str(svg), write_to=str(proof), output_width=1584, output_height=1584)
print("Rendered preview:", proof, flush=True)
with Image.open(proof) as rendered, Image.open(folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png") as supplied:
    assert rendered.size == supplied.size == (1584, 1584)
    assert rendered.convert("RGBA").tobytes() == supplied.convert("RGBA").tobytes(), "Rendered preview differs from supplied preview"
print("SVG XML, 44 × 44 inch size, editable text, and exact regeneration: valid")
print("CairoSVG version:", cairosvg.__version__)
print("Preview pixels match copied source; dimensions: 1584 × 1584")
print("SVG SHA-256:", hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())

# STAMPED in Practice: initial study poster

[stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg](stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg) is an editable **44 × 44 inch**
initial poster source with live text and a `3168 × 3168` viewBox.
The [PNG preview](stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png) is for screen review.
This layout contains no experiment findings and is awaiting author review.

ABCD data access was not obtained, so the planned scientific result has not been reproduced.
The proposed public-data studies do not resolve that controlled-data access limitation.
The seven-property table distinguishes implementation examples from **PENDING** evidence, effort,
failures, tradeoffs, and gaps.
The study question, dataset, sample size, and metric also remain pending; no general benefit from
skills is demonstrated.

Author order provisionally follows the conference program: John A. Lee, Austin Macdonald, Cody C.
Baker, and Yaroslav O. Halchenko.
Confirm the order before publication.
The descriptive subtitle is provisional; the submitted title remains in the
[accepted abstract](../stamped-abcd-poster-draft.md).

## Edit and regenerate

Edit [build_initial_poster.py](build_initial_poster.py) to change the content or layout
reproducibly, then regenerate the SVG.
The SVG can also be edited directly in a vector editor, but regeneration overwrites those direct
edits.
From this directory:

```bash
python3 build_initial_poster.py
uv run --with cairosvg cairosvg stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg \
  --output-width 1584 --output-height 1584 \
  --output stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png
```

The builder uses the Python standard library; preview rendering needs CairoSVG and the Cairo system
library.
With dependencies already cached, add `--offline` to `uv run`.
On Apple Silicon with Homebrew Cairo, prefix the rendering command with
`DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib` if the library is not found.
Local font selection can change text rendering or omit arrow glyphs; visually check a regenerated
preview against the supplied PNG.
The SVG retains its physical dimensions regardless of preview resolution.
Licensing follows the repository's existing [REUSE.toml](../../REUSE.toml) annotations.

# Concise reporting schema

The complete contract is [observation-v2.schema.json](../schemas/observation-v2.schema.json).
Both record kinds reject undeclared fields and invalid types, outcomes, UUIDs, timestamps, and negative resource values.
Duration requires an explicit scope; absent measurements remain null or omitted.

| Group | Optional information |
|---|---|
| Top-level flags | Task outcome, measured duration/scope, model, SKILL.md digest, measurement source |
| context | Opaque task/session IDs, project and revision, short summary, type, complexity, tags, related skills |
| execution | Trigger, host/runtime/version, provider/effort, OS/architecture, skill source/revision/full artifact digest, attempts, calls, errors, retries, exit code, start/end times, timing method |
| resources | Input/output/cached tokens, USD cost, peak RSS bytes, CPU seconds |
| quality | Verification method, tests passed/failed, human interventions, rework seconds, optional 1–5 rating, observed benefit, failure stage/code, confidence, notes |
| evidence | Typed URL/path/digest/evaluation/log references; no automatic copying of their contents |
| evaluation | Experiment/case, condition, split, metric/score, time/token budget |

Example `details.json` (illustrative values, not actual observations):

```json
{
  "context": {"task_summary": "Validate a release", "tags": ["testing"]},
  "execution": {"trigger": "agent", "attempts": 1, "tool_calls": 3, "retries": 0, "duration_method": "clock"},
  "resources": {"input_tokens": 1500, "output_tokens": 250},
  "quality": {"verification": "tests", "tests_passed": 12, "tests_failed": 0, "human_interventions": 0}
}
```

```console
pixi run feedback-local record duct --task build-validation --outcome success \
  --task-outcome success --duration-seconds 42 --duration-scope skill \
  --details details.json
```

Optional fields should make collection comprehensive when evidence exists, not require agents to fill every slot.
Host adapters can supply measured timestamps, tokens, runtime identity, and exit status; agents supply role-specific outcomes and short context.
A process exit code alone does not establish skill success.
Do not put unknowns in numeric fields as zero.

The minimal command runs only when called.
There is no automatic task-completion listener, timer, or implicit environment scan.
Existing v1 JSONL files remain untouched outside Git and are not silently reclassified or published.

## Rich skill-use capture

For substantive use, include an `assessment` in the details file and supply `--capture`.
